bullets.id: Emas spot ditutup Jumat di $3.537,90, turun $86,30 (2,38%), setelah sempat ke $3.502,93, terendah sejak September 2025. Kamis emas sudah turun 2,65% ke $3.625,50 karena klaim pengangguran 203.000 dan risalah Fed yang menunjukkan hampir semua pejabat memperkirakan kenaikan bunga lagi. Trading Economics menyebut ini penurunan mingguan terdalam dalam delapan bulan.
bullets.en: Spot gold closed Friday at $3,537.90, down $86.30 (2.38%), after touching $3,502.93, the lowest since September 2025. On Thursday gold had already fallen 2.65% to $3,625.50 on 203,000 jobless claims and Fed minutes showing nearly all officials expect further hikes. Trading Economics calls it the steepest weekly decline in eight months.

bullets.id: Trading Economics mencatat peluang 99% kenaikan 25 bps pada rapat Fed 8–9 Desember, dan Gubernur Christopher Waller menyebut kenaikan 50 bps bisa dipertimbangkan. Anehnya, yield 10 tahun turun ke sekitar 4,94% dan dolar melunak, tetapi emas tetap dijual seiring S&P 500 jatuh 3,70% dan masuk koreksi. Emas turun 14,64% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 37% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: Trading Economics shows a 99% chance of a 25 bp hike at the Fed’s Dec. 8–9 meeting, and Governor Christopher Waller said a 50 bp hike could be considered. Oddly, the 10-year yield fell to about 4.94% and the dollar softened, yet gold was still sold as the S&P 500 dropped 3.70% into correction. Gold is down 14.64% over the month and about 37% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Kitco mencatat resistance di $3.597 lalu $3.699, dengan support di $3.475 dan $3.447; jika $3.500 tertembus, target berikutnya $3.421 lalu zona $3.400–$3.420. Agenda: PMI awal November dan indeks Chicago Fed pada Senin 23 November, lalu rapat Fed 8–9 Desember.
bullets.en: Kitco lists resistance at $3,597 then $3,699, with support at $3,475 and $3,447; a break below $3,500 targets $3,421 and then the $3,400–$3,420 zone. Agenda: preliminary November PMIs and the Chicago Fed index on Monday, Nov. 23, then the Fed meeting on Dec. 8–9.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram turun Rp5.000 ke Rp2.495.000, turun lima hari beruntun, sementara buyback anjlok Rp50.000 ke Rp2.095.000, sehingga spread melebar ke Rp400.000 (sekitar 16%). Galeri24 di Rp2.356.000 (buyback Rp2.216.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS di Rp2.378.000 (buyback Rp2.192.000, spread sekitar 7,8%), keduanya turun sekitar Rp95.000–Rp97.000 sejak Rabu.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price fell Rp5,000 to Rp2,495,000, a fifth straight decline, while buyback plunged Rp50,000 to Rp2,095,000, widening the spread to Rp400,000 (about 16%). Galeri24 stands at Rp2,356,000 (buyback Rp2,216,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS at Rp2,378,000 (buyback Rp2,192,000, spread about 7.8%), both down about Rp95,000–Rp97,000 since Wednesday.
